title: Manipur: CoTU protest continues as SDSA opposes shutdown call after Taphou attack

ai.summary: Tensions in Manipur's Senapati and Kangpokpi districts rose after an armed attack on farmers at Taphou Kuki village killed one farmer and injured two others, prompting protests and a 48-hour shutdown as tribal groups clashed over security and jurisdiction.

facts.claim: armed attack on farmers at Taphou Kuki village
facts.quote: Tensions have risen in Manipur’s Senapati and Kangpokpi districts following an armed attack on farmers at Taphou Kuki village
The incident left 42-year-old farmer Kimneineng Chongloi dead

facts.claim: two other male farmers critically injured
facts.quote: two other male farmers critically injured while they were harvesting paddy

ai.background_note: A 48-hour shutdown was called by CoTU in response to an armed attack on farmers at Taphou Kuki village, which killed one farmer and injured two others.
